fields: Classic (0) is the original bidirectional response with smooth braking around stop. V/oct (1) is the alternate bidirectional pitch response: with the input attenuverter carefully adjusted, CV can track volts per octave. Forward only (2) runs from stop at fully CCW to maximum forward speed. Extended range and Unity at noon reshape these responses; V/oct is not a promise of calibrated tracking in every modified layout. If an older build changed your layout to forward only, select your preferred layout here and save options.txt after upgrading.
Off keeps stock ranges. On gives +/-4x in vsop 0/1, or stop to forward 8x in vsop 2.

Optional and off by default. Hold SHIFT alone for at least 0.5 seconds, then release to recall exact forward +1x. Varispeed holds there until the combined knob/CV input picks it up. Short taps still advance splices. Moving a knob, pressing another button or card activity cancels the reset. Keep the SHIFT input unpatched.
Places forward +1× at calibrated noon with zero Varispeed CV. In bidirectional layouts, stop and reverse fit into the left half. Choose any additional flat zones with ntch.

Widen the knob position for exact forward or reverse original speed. Each selected notch spans about 4% of knob travel. In the forward-only layout, 2 adds no notch and 3 adds only the forward notch. Scale steps still apply when quantized. Omit this line to follow vctr at boot (a forward notch with vctr 1) and keep the current notch setting on a settings-only reload.

0-100% of the calibrated control range, before layout, extended range and Unity at noon mapping. It is a knob position, not a playback-speed percentage. With vctr 1, 50% recalls forward +1x; otherwise speed depends on the selected layout and quantization. A later SHIFT unity recall replaces this hold.
Off: SHIFT + Varispeed locks to the scale. On: pitch is normally quantized; SHIFT + Varispeed temporarily becomes continuous. Release snaps back.
Applies to both quantization modes. Off disables quantization.
For octl 4: comma-separated 1-11, e.g. 3,5,7,10. Root and octaves are always included. 0 means root/octaves only.
Always included in this firmware. On removes the silent gaps at minimum Morph. Higher overlap settings stay unchanged.

0-100% virtual knob position. For normal unclocked playback with independent density off, 10% selects the stock seamless-loop setting (9-11%). At 0%, Morph Loop Off leaves a scheduling gap; Morph Loop On removes it. Higher values add overlap, then pitch/pan variation. Clock and independent density can change Gene spacing.

Sets the playback speed of Gene 2 at high Morph. Use 1 for unison, 2 for an octave up, or a negative ratio for reverse playback. Turing mode also uses these ratios. The magnitude can range from 0.0625 to 16, with up to eight decimal places. An explicit zero selects the minimum forward ratio, 0.0625.

Sets the playback speed of Gene 3 at high Morph. Use 1 for unison, 2 for an octave up, or a negative ratio for reverse playback. Turing mode also uses these ratios. The magnitude can range from 0.0625 to 16, with up to eight decimal places. An explicit zero selects the minimum forward ratio, 0.0625.

Sets the playback speed of Gene 4 at high Morph. Use 1 for unison, 2 for an octave up, or a negative ratio for reverse playback. Turing mode also uses these ratios. The magnitude can range from 0.0625 to 16, with up to eight decimal places. An explicit zero selects the minimum forward ratio, 0.0625.
Choose the original or smoother Gene envelope.

0-100% virtual knob position, not a percentage of the splice length. 0% and 1% play the longest Genes (the full splice); turning up shortens them, and 100% gives the shortest Genes. The response is nonlinear; actual duration also depends on the reel, speed and clock.
0-100% virtual knob position: move the Gene window from the beginning toward the end of the selected splice. Gene Size affects which portion is heard. This is not an absolute timestamp.

SHIFT + Slide position, 0-100%: 0% is no jitter, and increasing it widens Gene-start scatter. With sldm 1 this becomes repeating Turing spread. The response is nonlinear, not a percentage of reel length.

With dens 1, dstr selects startup timing. Its default is 1 Gene/sec. Hold SHIFT and turn Gene Size to select stock timing at fully CCW. Turn slightly clockwise for 0.1 Genes/sec, through 8 at noon to 128 at fully CW. Pitch and Morph can change while the selected rate stays fixed. Unshifted Gene Size sets length. Panel edits last until another adjustment, an explicit dstr reload or power-off. The module keeps the configured value in options.txt. Overrides the Turing rate gesture; external clock takes priority.

Enter 0 for stock Gene timing or 0.1–128 for a rate in Genes/sec, in steps of 0.1. The default is 1.0 Gene/sec. With dens 1, SHIFT + Gene Size remains available after either choice. If your card already says dstr 8.0, it will still start at 8 Genes/sec. Change it to 0 for stock timing or 1 for one Gene per second. An external clock takes priority.
In hybrid mode, Morph selects Gene shifting or time stretching. Choose a fixed mode to use the clock for one function across the Morph range.
Send the signal envelope or a ramp timed to the current Gene Size.
Choose which button gesture starts a recording into the current splice and which creates a new splice.
For ordinary recording, S.O.S. blends the input with Gene playback. Choose input only to capture the live input at any S.O.S. position. Dry kill modes 2 and 3 use their own recording sources.

Mode 0 monitors the S.O.S. curve. Modes 1–3 monitor only Gene playback. Mode 1 keeps the ordinary recording source and SHIFT feedback controls. Mode 2 mixes with stored audio under the tape head on fixed overdubs. Mode 3 mixes with performed Gene playback, including Varispeed, Morph, Gene Size and Slide.
3: Wet only, record Gene playback with S.O.S.

0 fades in existing audio up to noon, then fades out incoming audio. Both are at full level at noon. 1 keeps incoming audio full and fades in existing audio clockwise. 2 keeps existing audio full and fades out incoming audio clockwise. An omitted line selects 0 on startup or either card load. The first take on an empty reel always records full input. Choose sosc 1 with dryk 2 for the c4 full-input overdub.

Applies only to dryk 2. Fixed keeps the loop length and overdubs inside the Slide and Gene Size window. Extend works with sosc 0 or 1 and checks S.O.S. when REC starts. On the last or only splice, fully CCW (the lowest 4.5% of the effective knob/CV range, including a recalled S.O.S. preset) starts a replacement at the splice beginning. Input records forward at 1×, independent of Varispeed, Slide and Gene Size. Stop REC to set a longer end. A shorter take keeps the old length and tail. The selected recording mode lasts until REC stops. Earlier splices and takes started above the CCW zone use fixed-length overdubs with normal feedback.
1: Extend the last splice at fully CCW
Selects tape overdub or classic TLA feedback for SHIFT + S.O.S. and fbkp in dryk 0 and 1. Modes 2 and 3 use their dedicated recording paths and main S.O.S. knob.

SHIFT + S.O.S. virtual knob position for dryk 0 and 1. With tape 1, this sets how much of the old pass is retained; with tape 0 and inop 0, it sets the Gene playback contribution. Modes 2 and 3 take their feedback setting from the main S.O.S. knob or its preset (sosp).
Primary S.O.S. virtual knob position on the selected sosc curve. At 50% in the default crossfade, both incoming and existing audio are at full level.
Limits overlap while tape-dubbing. 0 disables the cap; 1-9 means 0.1-0.9. Higher values can increase glitches.

Selects one playback effect: sample-rate reduction or warble; they cannot run together. srrp and wrbp retain separate recalled amounts. Without an amount preset, startup uses the existing reset behavior. Warble uses less CPU than sample-rate reduction.

SHIFT + Morph position, 0-100%: 0% bypasses SRR; increasing it strengthens sample-rate reduction. Active with fxsl 1. This is the knob curve, not a bit-depth or sample-rate percentage. Stored separately from warble; fxsl 0 bypasses both effects.

SHIFT + Morph position, 0-100%: 0% is no warble; higher values add stronger wow/flutter. Active with fxsl 2. This is the knob curve, not a pitch percentage. Stored separately from SRR; only the selected effect runs.
SHIFT + Organize: evolution; SHIFT + Slide: repeating scatter; SHIFT + Gene Size: Genes per step when dens is off.

SHIFT + Organize position, 0-100%, used with sldm 1. 0% locks the repeating pattern; 100% produces fresh randomness. Intermediate values follow the existing nonlinear knob curve, not a literal probability percentage.

Choose 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12 or 16 Genes per step. Used with sldm 1; dens 1 takes priority over the Turing rate. An explicit zero recalls 1 Gene per step. Unchecked preserves the live Turing rate on reload.
Number of repeating random steps, 1–16. An explicit zero selects 1 step.
Chance of choosing the root rather than a chord ratio from mcr1-mcr3. 100 disables pitch changes.
Classic checks the gate at the end of each Gene or splice. Momentary starts and stops with the gate. Trigger loop keeps playing and jumps to the start set by Slide and Organize on each rising edge.

Select when the new splice takes over during normal Organize or SHIFT navigation, splice preset recall, and final confirmation in the bank picker. With 0, a switch to another reel starts loading at the next Gene transition. With 1, the load starts when you confirm.

The top 5% clockwise of Organize plays through the reel. Mode 1 always steps forward. Mode 2 follows Varispeed direction and wraps in either direction. The lower 95% still selects every splice manually. For one pass per splice, use full-length Genes and stock Gene timing. Short Genes or a clock can step sooner. Recording pauses automatic stepping. Omit the line for off at boot and to keep the live setting on a settings-only reload.

0 uses the card root and the ordinary reel browser. 1 enables banks and starts at the root. Banks 2–8 use folders bank2 through bank8, with up to 32 reels per bank. Existing folders appear in the picker even when empty. Hold SPLICE, add REC and wait for REEL to blink. Release both. Turn Organize to choose a bank, reel and splice in turn. Confirm each with a short SPLICE-then-REC chord. Tap SHIFT to cancel. At the reel step, a lone recorded reel double-flashes. When space is available, the last 5% clockwise selects pink/white New Reel. In an empty bank that choice spans the whole dial. Confirm New Reel to open a blank. For a new reel in the current bank, use the ordinary short chord, turn Organize fully clockwise, then confirm with a second short chord. A settings-only reload keeps the current bank.

With 0, the bank step keeps playing the current performance. The reel step previews the first splice, and the splice step previews the highlighted splice. Previews play forward at +1×. The current performance keeps running underneath. With 1, you hear that performance throughout browsing. A missing line enables audition on boot and on a successful settings-only reload. The ordinary short reel browser keeps its native audition.

Splice numbers run from 1 to 300. Both 0 and 1 recall the first splice. A number above the loaded reel count selects its last splice while keeping your configured number. Unchecked keeps normal startup selection and preserves the current splice on settings-only reload.
Stock gain index, 0-3. REC held + SHIFT taps changes it on the module; the mod saves it after about 3 seconds.
Always copies L to both channels and ignores R. Auto copies L only while R is quiet.
Enable this to use the right signal input to modulate playback position while the left input has no signal.
Writes cpulog.txt periodically. Leave off for normal performance.
features: Eight reel banks on one card

Enable bank 1 to keep the root as bank 1. Add folders named bank2 through bank8 as needed. Each bank holds up to 32 reels with their own splice markers. The picker includes existing folders, even empty ones. Choose the pink/white New Reel at the reel step to open a blank for recording.

Hold SPLICE, add REC and keep both down until REEL blinks. Release both, turn Organize, and confirm the bank, reel and splice with short SPLICE-then-REC chords. By default, audt 0 previews the highlighted reel’s first splice, then the highlighted splice, at forward +1×. Your performance keeps running underneath. Tap SHIFT to return to it, or set audt 1 to hear it throughout browsing. A short initial chord still opens the ordinary reel browser.
Play through splices in either direction

Turn Organize into its top 5% clockwise to play splices in sequence. thru 1 steps through splice numbers in ascending order. thru 2 follows Varispeed, so reversing also steps to the previous splice. Both wrap around the reel. Use full-length Genes and stock timing for one pass per splice, or shorten the Genes to step sooner.

Use ntch 1 for a forward +1× notch, ntch 2 for a reverse −1× notch, or ntch 3 for both. Each spans about 4% of the dial. Choose ntch 0 for a continuous sweep with quantization off. vctr 1 still puts forward unity at noon.

Confirm a splice with omod 0 to switch at the current Gene transition, or omod 1 to switch immediately. Across reels or banks, the SD load begins at that point. Tap SHIFT to cancel a queued cross-reel change before the load starts.

The module can now detect an idle card’s removal even when a cached filesystem read would have kept SHIFT lit. After writes finish, remove the card and wait for SHIFT to go dark. Insert and tap SHIFT for a normal load, or hold SHIFT until it lights and insert a matching card for a settings-only swap.

Set dens 1 and dstr 0 to boot with stock Gene timing and keep SHIFT + Gene Size available. On a settings-only reload, include dstr to recall stock timing or a rate from 0.1 to 128 Genes/sec. Omit it to keep the live timing. A fresh boot with no dstr line uses 1 Gene/sec. An existing dstr 8.0 still selects 8 Genes/sec. External clock takes priority, and available voices limit the overlap of long Genes.

Choose the S.O.S. recording curve with sosc. Its default gives full incoming and existing audio at noon. With dryk 3, existing audio is the performed Gene playback. Record into a new splice to keep your source, or overdub the current splice.

Set dryk 1 to hear only Gene playback while keeping your usual recording controls. With dryk 2, the knob mixes incoming audio with the existing samples under the tape head. dryk 0 monitors the selected curve.

Keep a beat loop at its original length with dlen 0. With dryk 2 and dlen 1, select sosc 0 or sosc 1 and start REC fully counterclockwise on S.O.S. to replace the last or only splice from its start. A longer take extends it. A shorter take keeps its old end.

Enable vuni 1, hold SHIFT alone for at least half a second, then release to return to exact forward +1x from any Varispeed position. Soft pickup holds the speed until the combined knob/CV input reaches or crosses it. Short SHIFT taps retain ordinary splice navigation.

Enable vctr 1 to place forward +1x at calibrated noon in full-range and bidirectional layouts, with every quantized scale. Omit ntch on boot for the original 48–52% centered notch, or choose your notches explicitly. Stop and reverse fit into the left half in bidirectional modes. Both unity options default to off.

All dialable values can now be included in prepared options: Morph, Gene Size, Slide, Varispeed, S.O.S. mix, feedback, effects, Turing evolution and Genes per step, alongside density and gain. Select a splice too. Each new recall is optional; unchecked values stay live during settings-only reload. Included controls resume from their recalled positions through soft pickup.

SRR and warble retain separate amounts; fxsl selects one or bypasses both. splc selects a numbered splice; a number above the reel count selects the last while retaining your configured number. Normal saves preserve configured presets, not subsequent knob movements.

Enable vrng 1 for +/-4x, or combine it with vsop 2 for stop to forward 8x. Choose octaves, fifths, semitones or a custom scale. vqnt 1 keeps pitch quantized normally; SHIFT + Varispeed temporarily frees it. Default vqnt 0 retains SHIFT-to-lock.

mlop 1 removes the gaps at minimum Morph; default mlop 0 retains them. The stock seamless-loop setting is also available with mpos 10 under normal unclocked scheduling. SHIFT + Morph controls SRR or warble, and SHIFT + Slide controls start jitter.

SHIFT + S.O.S. controls tape overdub or classic TLA feedback. With sldm 1, SHIFT + Organize controls evolution, SHIFT + Slide controls repeating spread, and SHIFT + Gene Size sets Genes per step when independent density is off.

Remove the idle card, hold SHIFT alone for one second, then insert a prepared matching card while still holding SHIFT. The live reel stays loaded and the card remains mounted for recording and saving. Explicit presets recall; omitted ones preserve their live state. An explicit splice recall intentionally changes selection.
Input gain is remembered. Mono input can copy L onto both channels. Updates can be installed from SD after the first audio install. Includes Briskcat’s splice-overdub fix and flash prefetch.
